name: NF P 03-001 — General Conditions for Private Construction Contracts
description: Validates private building contracts in France. Runs today: retention within the 5 percent ceiling of loi 71-584 and the subcontractor payment guarantee (caution or délégation de paiement) of loi 75-1334 art. 14. The NF P 03-001:2017 clauses themselves (price structure, penalties, reception, insurance, disputes) are planned, not built: the standard is a paid AFNOR document that was not read, so none of its figures are encoded.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
superseded_rule_ids_note: nfp03.retenue_garantie_max_5_pct was dropped: the 5 percent ceiling comes from loi 71-584, not from the standard, and contracts.private_works_retention_cap checks it.
